shortDescription: Access and Update Google Cloud Parameter Manager objects

options.name: access_token
options.description: An OAuth2 access token if credential type is accesstoken.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: format
options.description: Format of the parameter to be used.

options.name: labels
options.description: A set of key-value pairs to assign as labels to a parameter only used in creation Note that the "value" piece of a label must contain only readable chars

options.name: location
options.description: Location of the parameter to be used

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the parameter to be used

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use. Defaults to OS env variable GCP_PROJECT if not present

options.name: return_value
options.description: if true, the value of the parameter will be returned unencrypted to Ansible if false, no value will be returned or decrypted

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: value
options.description: The parameter value that the parameter should have this will be set upon create If the parameter value is not this, a new version will be added with this value

options.name: version
options.description: Name of the parameter to be used
